The '''C5 tractor beam emitter''', manufactured by [[Phylon Transport/Legends|Phylon]], was a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] emitter commercially available for cargo loading. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] owned by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], was equipped with two C5 emitters within the forward mandibles of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Although the emitters were only capable of lifting 900kg at a range of 30 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], Solo's co-pilot [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was skilled enough at the controls to capture falling bodies with the tractor beams.<ref name="MFOWMpg" />
